name: AuxPair.lift_auxDatum_eq_lift_modDatum
summary: Write Υ as the sum over A ∈ ∏_{w∈Q} GL_r(k_w) of translates of the level-indicator datum; each translate fixes y, so by equivariance every summand gives the same lift.

steps.claim: For every A in TwistGL(O, r), every finite datum f and every point g: the lift of y with the datum v ⊗ f moved by (1, twistLift(O, A)) equals, at g, the lift of the translate of y by twistLift(O, A) with the datum v ⊗ f (equivariance of the theta lift, `ThetaKernel.lift_equivariant`, y being automorphic by hy).
steps.lean:
have e A f g :=
    (O.pairThetaKernel.lift_equivariant hy.1 (integrated _ v f) (1, (O.twistLift A).1) 1 g).symm

steps.claim: Write Υ = auxDatum(O) as the sum over A ∈ TwistGL(O, r) of the translates by (1, twistLift(O, A)) of modDatum(levelIndicator(O), vac) (`AuxPair.upsilon_eq_sum`). Each twistLift(O, A) reduces to 1 at the places of M (`reduceFamily_liftResidue`), so it lies in levelOf(chosenPlace(O), ⊥) (`mem_levelOf`) and fixes y by h. By step 1 every summand gives the lift of y by v ⊗ modDatum(levelIndicator(O)); the lift is linear in the datum (`ThetaKernel.exists_clm_lift`), so the sum is #TwistGL(O, r) times this lift, which is the lift by modDatum(#TwistGL(O, r)·levelIndicator(O), v).
steps.lean:
simp_all [upsilon_eq_sum, ← Prod.mk_one_one, fun A ↦ h _ (mem_levelOf.2 ⟨(O.twistLift A).2, funext
    (congrFun (reduceFamily_liftResidue (w := O.placeAt) _) <| inl ·)⟩),
    (O.pairThetaKernel.exists_clm_lift hy).choose_spec, funext_iff, modDatum, Pi.smul_comp]
